case_title: Pundappa Yan Kappa Pujari v. State of Karnataka
neutral_facts: The accused, Pundappa Yankappa Pujari, and his brother Siddappa Pundappa Pujari were involved in a land dispute with the deceased, Mahantappa. On 5th July 1997, while removing a boundary stone, an altercation occurred between Pundappa and Mahantappa. Pundappa assaulted Mahantappa with an axe on the neck and head, causing severe injuries, while Siddappa assaulted him with a stick. Witnesses, including Laxmawwa, Sangappa, and Chandrasekhar, saw the incident and reported it. The deceased was taken to the hospital, where he later died from his injuries. Medical evidence confirmed the cause of death was due to the injuries sustained during the assault. The trial court acquitted both accused, but the High Court convicted Pundappa of murder under Section 302 IPC.
